changelog:
Initial release: Query and export Alibaba Cloud WAF 3.0 billing data with local backup support.

- Retrieve WAF instance and region information automatically.
- Query WAF bills by day or hour, including SeCU and Credit usage details.
- Automatically handle T+1 settlement restriction for pay-as-you-go bills (adjusts queries by date).
- Export billing data and summaries as JSON/CSV to a date-organized local backup directory.
- Pure read-only operation: never exposes credentials, only reads and backs up billing data.
- Requires aliyun-cli ≥ 3.3.3 and read-only RAM permissions.
summary: Query and back up Alibaba Cloud WAF 3.0 billing data. Use this Skill when a user asks to check WAF bills, export WAF cost details, back up WAF billing data locally, or analyze daily/hourly SeCU and Credit usage. The Skill retrieves instance information, daily bill summaries, and hourly cost breakdowns (function fees, traffic processing fees, Credit usage) via aliyun-cli, then exports the results as JSON and CSV files to the local workspace.
